newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chemical Industries in S$50 mln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Chemical Industries in S$50 mln bond issue.

text.p: Chemical Industries (Far East) Ltd said on Tuesday it was proposing a Singapore $50 million bond issue with 11.95 million warrants attached.
The company said in a statement OCBC Bank would place out the 2 1/2 percent five year bonds to financial institutions and other investors.
It said OCBC would offer the warrants on a three for 10 basis to shareholders at Singapore $0.60 for each warrant.
Warrant holders can subscribe for shares at any time within five years from the date of issue.
It said the purpose of the issue was to raise medium term funds at a favourable effective interest rate.

Proceeds from the issue, estimated at about S$50.1 million, will be used to finance the development of a new factory at Pulau Sakra and a new logistics base at Pulau Samulun, both islands near Singapore.
